prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one standalone professional image for an Arabic family visual guessing game (age 16+).
Subject: an adult track athlete swinging a hammer throw implement, ball on a wire, in a throwing circle.
Style: realistic high quality photography with correct anatomy and object geometry, clean natural textures.
Composition: landscape 4:3, the complete subject fills about 75% of the frame; centered with ample margins, immediately recognizable when revealed.  
Background: simple uncluttered setting appropriate to the subject, natural lighting.
Constraints: exactly the stated subject; no label, caption, watermark, collage, borders or readable words. Create a sharp original, not a blurred image; the game applies the blur.  The subject must be visually unambiguous, with a strong clear outline and identifying features large enough to survive a moderate blur. Do not add any text or split-panel layout. Keep the entire subject in frame.
Sports accuracy: one adult athlete holding a single handle with both hands, one thin taut wire running unobstructed from that handle to one clearly visible heavy spherical metal ball. Capture an anatomically correct two-footed stance in a throwing circle, entire body and full wire and ball visible, no detached wire or duplicated arms; no motion blur on the implement.

review.note: Full-size image shows an athlete standing inside a circular throwing area within a cage, both hands on a handle joined by one continuous taut wire to a spherical metal head. The hammer equipment and pose are coherent for class identification. Fine wire disappears in the approximate static blur; contextual question about a ball attached to a wire matters. A conspicuous swoosh-like shoe mark remains a minor no-logo brief issue, separate from successful subject identity.
